name: TOB Sunday School Quiz Attempt
description: One student's submission for a TOB Sunday School Weekly Quiz. score/total_marks/rank are only ever written server-side by truth_of_bible.sunday_school.engine.finalize_quiz() grading against TOB Sunday School Weekly Quiz Question.correct_option — never trusted from the client, same discipline as qmp_lms_bridge's quiz grading. answers stores the student's raw picks (JSON list of A/B/C/D) purely for the admin review screen; it plays no role in scoring once graded.

fields.label: Score
fields.description: Set by finalize_quiz() once the quiz is closed. Null while the quiz is still open.

fields.label: Rank
fields.description: 1-indexed placement among this quiz's attempts, set once results finalize.

fields.label: Answers
fields.description: JSON list of the student's selected options, in question order.
